cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the Central Bank of Mauritania licenses or authorises mobile money, e-money or payment service providers.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 114), each step met on its own evidence: MRT-003 shows the central bank's oversight of payment systems activated, but no source says it licenses payment providers; GIMTEL's interconnection of bank apps and e-wallets was the higher fact.
